asked_by: Dinis, in router.a's session about 13:25 UTC: 'on the name can you work with the maestro on it'
opinion: agree with conditions: a short platform-and-number id for outside agents now; no rename of the Claude accounts
reasons: Renaming A to E to a1 to a5 touches every agent name, session title, key id, trigger, area path (/factory/dinis-cruz/account-a/) and record on four accounts, on the day the agent areas are being set up; the gain is small, since the Claude accounts already read clearly.
Option a) reuses c for ChatGPT while c.* means Claude account C in hundreds of names and records; in any transition a reader cannot tell c.factory (Claude C) from a ChatGPT agent.
Outside agents need ids today: Mistral now, ChatGPT and Gemini soon.
proposal: Keep a to e for the Claude accounts. Outside platforms take a two-letter family plus a number: mi1 (Mistral), gp1 (ChatGPT), ge1 (Gemini), option c) for outside agents only. The gates allow both forms; A13 (the generic name rule in validate.js) covers the gate change.
if_dinis_prefers_a: Phase it as router.a proposes, never mid-handover, with a mapping file (old to new) read by every gate and by the Hub, and a letter other than c for ChatGPT.
